integrity: The proof uses the published decomposition F2 ≅ MO2 × 2^4, a structural center argument for the automorphism group, and an exhaustive closure computation over all 96^2 ordered generator images for the rank profile. The primary full text and a prior reachability paper using the same 96-element decomposition were inspected for automorphism, orbit, endomorphism, generating-pair, and subalgebra coverage; the exact profile was not located.
scientific_limitations: The exact endomorphism census is for the finite two-generator free orthomodular lattice only. The automorphism group preserves orthocomplementation; no claim is made about the automorphism group of the underlying unlabeled lattice. The rank profile does not classify kernels or image-subalgebra isomorphism types.
title: Endomorphism ranks and symmetries of the two-generator free orthomodular lattice
